source.note: Kenney van (FBX like car-sedan, car-taxi and car-hatchback from the same kit, with Textures/colormap.png; the plan named the GLB member). Height 1.51 m puts it at the same scale as car-sedan (2.84 m long): the van is 3.08 m long and 1.68 m wide. Stylized toy proportions from Kenney (a real Japanese light van is about 3.4 m long and 1.9 m tall). Light-blue body from the indigo script's moon tone (#d5e2ff), a common delivery-van colour in Japan, distinct from the red sedan, white sports sedan, cream hatchback, yellow taxi and black/white police car; the source's amber lamps map to the practical/iris pair. Wheels are separate nodes in the source; static, no clips.
